_comment: Seed manifest for the RealWorld/Conduit CALIBRATION target (plan-005 U7, R4). Conduit is the articles archetype (a Medium clone). Unlike every other target, its ground truth is the PUBLISHED RealWorld spec, not our inference — so the grader is Gauge-R&R'd against the spec-derived verdicts in spec.json. Seeding is live/docker-required (the generic harness drives Conduit's REST API headlessly); the spec-derived calibration slice's reference verdicts are defined against THIS post-seed state. Offline the manifest is shape-validated only.

articles.title: Calibrating a grader against a published spec
Why the calibration target needs ground truth
